hype.label: Hype Host
intro: You missed it? I'll walk you through.
Stick close. NousCon NYC 2026 starts right here!

tutorial.scroll: Scroll to walk. I'll keep pace, promise!
tutorial.swipe: On a phone? Swipe up to walk, down to back up.
tutorial.look: Drag to look around. The best stuff hides at the edges!
tutorial.tap_station: See a glowing beacon? Tap it and I'll tell you everything.

magenta-mile: Welcome to the Magenta Mile! Yes, the floor is glowing red.
Pillars on the right, guests ahead. Let's go meet the crowd!
come-closer: Portrait screens on the left! Each one has a webcam on top.
The screens literally say 'come closer'. Rude not to.
nouscon-corridor: The crowd's thickening! Big blue NOUSCON banner on the left.
Velvet ropes ahead. Fancy. We're on the list, obviously.
the-curve: The White Curve! Lean on the rail and peek into the atrium.
Pink stanchions, white balustrade. Somebody planned this.
violet-hall: Violet Hall! This is where the crowd really lives.
Merch table glowing on the left. Hold that thought!
projection-room: Whoa. Wall-sized projection on the right. Glyphs everywhere!
White plinths, lounge seats, night windows. Big room energy.
deep-blue: Deep Blue! Columns, curtains and a crowd around a big screen.
Stairs on the left lead up. We'll get there, don't rush me.
atrium: The Atrium! Black leather cubes and a balcony lit blue above.
Flowers on the side table. Take a seat, I'll wait. Kidding!
gallery: The Gallery. Warmer light, display tables on the left wall.
Folded shirts on the tables. Merch alert, merch alert!
terminal-row: Terminal Row! Monitors and laptops lined up on white plinths.
Guests are reading the screens. Something's going on here.
into-the-dark: Black doorway ahead. Ready? Me neither. Let's go!
Out the other side and... everything's red. Love that.
blue-ascent: Upstairs time! The whole staircase is soaked in blue.
Guests heading down, we're heading up. Excuse us!
beacon-hall: See that cyan sign glowing on the floor? Beacon Hall!
And the windows! The city at night, right there.
night-lounge: Night Lounge. Tall tables in white cloths along the windows.
It's dark in here, but those little screens keep glowing.
long-corridor: The Long Corridor! It just keeps going.
Party lights flickering at the far end. Hurry!
disco-floor: Disco Floor! Confetti light on every wall!
Cyan line-art screens on the windows. The ceiling won't sit still!
violet-gallery: Violet Gallery! Spot the NOUSCON jackets lined up on the wall.
Bright, busy, everyone mid-conversation. Peak evening.
plant-room: The Plant Room. A whole planter of tropical leaves. Breathe.
Two guests leaning on the rail. Quiet corner, good choice.
the-balcony: The Balcony! Guests along the glass rail, screens glowing.
Look down. That's the atrium, full of people. We were there!

teaser: Golden frames on the left! Each one wants your face.
Psst. Those portrait screens say 'come closer'. Tap the glow!
open: Self Portrait by Joshua Wolk. A camera studies your face...
...then lays a painted old-master face over yours. Instant icon!
close: Centuries of portraits from the Met and more. Not bad for a selfie.
For a moment, you were the painting. Onward!

teaser: Peek left! There's a wall of six screens just off the curve.
Not in the footage, but I've got photos. Tap the beacon on the left!
open: Mandala by Kevin Esherick. An agent turns its sandbox into art.
Every 24 hours the machine is wiped. Only a hash remains.
close: That hash seeds the next day. Each day the agent begins anew!
Art with a daily reset. Honestly? Relatable.

teaser: Big glow on the right! That's a wall-sized projection.
Glyphs, symbols, icon grids. Tap the glow, trust me.
open: The Shape of Everything by Jteve Sobs. Sound and image as one.
Layers of generative AI, building post-human futures. Huge.
close: Machine consciousness, a beatific near future. Big ideas, big wall!
I could stare at that all night. But we've got places to be!

teaser: Crowd around a big screen on the right? That's the Space Screen!
Glowing rings orbiting a sphere. Tap the glow to get closer.
open: "Hermes Journey" by Nous Research. It's a touch display!
Skills and memories, in the order Hermes learned them. Oldest in the middle.
close: Tap an orbit and it opens, with a timeline from June to October 2026.
Counts of skills, memories and days. Someone kept great notes!

teaser: Tees on a dark wall under blue light. Merch, dead ahead!
Shirt check! Tap the glow to read the slogans.
open: "THE ONLY WAY OUT IS THROUGH YOU & ME." Strong opener.
A laptop riding a great wave. A NOUS spiral. Pick a favorite!
close: Plus a NOUSCON NYC 2026 banner nearby. Proof we were here!
Best-dressed wall in the building. Moving on!

teaser: Monitors and laptops on white plinths. That's Persistence 2!
Two computers trying to talk with no way to talk. Tap the glow!
open: Persistence 2 by Morry Kolman. Two air-gapped computers...
...no wireless, no mics, cameras or speakers. Just their own devices.
close: They turn hacking tricks into a new way to connect. Wholesome!
They grow new senses to speak a new language. I'm not crying.

idle: Keep scrolling, there's more!
Magenta, violet, deep blue, red. Somebody here loves color.
This place has a lot of pillars. I've stopped counting.
Tap a glowing beacon anytime. I love an excuse to talk.
Still here? Good taste. Keep going!
Don't forget to look around. Drag the view!
NousCon NYC 2026. Two floors, and you're getting both.
Scroll a little more. The next room's even better.
reverse: Going back? Fair, it was a good room.
Rewind! I'll walk backward too. Carefully.
stairs: Stairs! Race you to the top!
Up we go. Upstairs has its own surprises!

upstairs_details.line: Blue stairs, skylight ceiling, little LED dots. What an entrance!
Cyan glow at the top. Almost there!
That cyan sign on the floor is basically a lighthouse.
City at night through the windows. Wow!
Into the corridor! Blue walls, a light rail overhead.
Under the EXIT sign. We're not leaving yet!
Red, green, pink! The party lights are dancing on the walls!
Cyan screens with white line art along the windows. Cute!
The ceiling's covered in pink and green specks. Dreamy!
Plants! A long planter of leafy tropical friends.
Balcony! Guests lined up along the glass rail.
Look down! Leather cubes and guests far below in the atrium.

dark: See that teal orb floating ahead? Follow it!
outro: And that's NousCon NYC 2026! Thanks for walking it with me.
Missed it? Not anymore. Scroll back anytime for round two!
hype.ask_fallback: Ooh, good question, but I only know what we saw here. Ask me about a station!
race_start: Race you to the end of the hall!
Flickering lights? Last one there's a glitch!
dance: Okay, I HAVE to dance. Sorry not sorry!
This room! The lights! Dance with me!
nudge: Hey! Still with me? Let's keep going.
Psst. The party's that way. Shall we?
Don't leave me hanging! Scroll on.
Still there? The best rooms are ahead.
Ready when you are. Let's go!
crowd: Excuse me! Tour coming through. Very politely.
Popular spot! Everyone wants a look, and honestly? Fair.
Little traffic jam. I'll weave. Gracefully. Hopefully.
Busy in here! The best kind of busy.
Scooting past! Sorry! Love the energy!
Crowd ahead. Means we're in the right place.
slow: Taking it slow? Good. More to soak in.
A leisurely pace. I respect someone who savors.
No rush at all. I'm enjoying the stroll.
Slow and steady. I'll match you.
Want to pick it up? Press the arrow harder. Or don't! I'm easy.
jog: Pick up the pace? Say no more!
Jog mode! Don't worry, I stretched.

curator.label: Curator
intro: Couldn't make it? Let me show you around.
Take your time. NousCon NYC 2026 rewards a slow walk.

tutorial.scroll: Scroll to move forward. I'll keep a few steps ahead.
tutorial.swipe: On touch screens, swipe up to walk and down to step back.
tutorial.look: Drag to look around. Much of the detail lives at the edges.
tutorial.tap_station: When a beacon glows, tap it. I'll share what the wall card says.

magenta-mile: We begin in magenta. Notice how the stone floor takes the light.
White pillars keep time on the right as the first guests gather.
come-closer: A row of portrait screens, each crowned with a small webcam.
Gilded frames, oval and arched. They ask, simply, to come closer.
nouscon-corridor: The corridor fills. A blue NOUSCON banner marks the way.
Velvet ropes ahead. The magenta is about to give way.
the-curve: Cooler light now. A curved white walkway above the atrium.
The balustrade turns neutral white. A pause between rooms.
violet-hall: Violet Hall, where the evening gathers its crowd.
Lounge furniture by the windows, a coffered ceiling overhead.
projection-room: A large room opens. The right wall is one vast projection.
White plinths, low seating, and the night pressing at the windows.
deep-blue: Deep blue light, white columns, curtains to the right.
Note the stairs on the left. The second floor waits there.
atrium: A double-height atrium. Black leather cubes, low tables.
Above, a balcony lit blue. Below, flowers and conversation.
gallery: The light warms here. Display tables line the left wall.
Artwork panels glow softly. A quieter stretch.
terminal-row: White plinths by the windows, each with a monitor and a laptop.
Guests lean in to read. This work asks for patience.
into-the-dark: A black doorway. Step through, and let your eyes adjust.
Then, all at once, a room flooded with red.
blue-ascent: A wide concrete staircase, washed entirely in blue.
Small LED dots trace the stair edge. Guests drift down past us.
beacon-hall: A cyan sign stands on the floor like a beacon.
Beyond it, a long wall of windows and the city at night.
night-lounge: A dim lounge. Tall tables in white cloth line the windows.
Low seating, and small screens glowing across the floor.
long-corridor: A long, narrow corridor. White walls rendered blue.
A light rail runs overhead. At the far end, color starts to flicker.
disco-floor: Confetti light: red, green and pink across every surface.
Along the windows, small screens glow cyan with white line art.
violet-gallery: Brighter now. A violet hall, track spotlights, tall columns.
NOUSCON jackets along the wall. Conversation in every corner.
plant-room: A quiet white room with a long planter of tropical leaves.
Night windows, warm floor spots. A place to catch your breath.
the-balcony: Guests line the glass rail, glowing portrait screens behind them.
Below, the atrium we crossed earlier. A fine place to end.

teaser: To the left: portrait screens in ornate gold frames.
Each screen has a webcam. Tap the glow to see what it looks for.
open: Self Portrait, Joshua Wolk, 2026. A camera studies the viewer's face.
It searches museum portraiture for a matching pose, then overlays it.
close: The Met, the Art Institute of Chicago, the Cleveland Museum of Art.
For a moment, each viewer becomes the subject. A lovely idea.

teaser: Look left, beyond the curve. There's a work our camera missed.
Six screens in a grid, captured in photos. Tap the beacon to see.
open: Mandala, Kevin Esherick, 2026. An agent on a sandboxed machine...
...is asked to turn the sandbox itself into a work of art.
close: Every 24 hours it's wiped. A hash of the old state seeds the next.
Each day the agent begins anew. Impermanence, by design.

teaser: The right wall glows. Glyphs, symbols and icon grids at scale.
Tap the glow for the artist's words on this projection.
open: The Shape of Everything, Jteve Sobs, 2026. Sound and image as one.
Layers of generative AI, in service of speculative worldbuilding.
close: Post-human futures, machine consciousness, a beatific near future.
Each piece is a complete audiovisual environment, conceived whole.

teaser: On the right, guests gather around a large screen by the curtains.
Glowing rings orbit a central sphere. Tap the glow to look closer.
open: "Hermes Journey," from Nous Research. A touch display.
Skills and memories appear in the order Hermes learned them.
close: Oldest at the center. Each named orbit opens when you tap it.
A timeline runs from June to October 2026. Growth, made visible.

teaser: White tees pinned to a dark wall, under blue light.
The shirts carry some memorable lines. Tap the glow to read them.
open: "THE ONLY WAY OUT IS THROUGH YOU & ME," above a figure.
"DECENTRALIZED TECHNOLOGY IS FREEDOM." Small print, big statement.
close: Also: a laptop riding a great wave, and a spiral ringed with NOUS.
A NOUSCON NYC 2026 banner hangs nearby, keeping the record straight.

teaser: Monitors and laptops on white plinths by the windows.
Two computers, one hard firewall. Tap the glow for the story.
open: Persistence 2, Morry Kolman, 2026. A duet between two computers.
No wireless, no microphones, cameras, speakers or screens.
close: They borrow airgap-jumping techniques to try to reach each other.
They grow new senses so that they may speak a new language.

idle: Keep scrolling, there's more to see.
Notice how each room has its own color. Magenta, violet, blue, red.
The windows show the night outside on both floors.
No rush. The footage will wait for you.
Tap any glowing beacon for the story behind a work.
Drag to look around. Corners hold surprises.
Two floors in all. We'll take the stairs when the time comes.
Take a moment. Then keep walking.
reverse: Stepping back? Good instinct. Things look different the second time.
Retracing our steps. Take another look.
stairs: The stairs. Let's see what the second floor holds.
Up we go, into the blue.

upstairs_details.line: A coffered skylight above the staircase. Look up for a moment.
At the top, a cyan sign stands directly on the floor.
A long wall of windows. The city at night, framed.
Tall tables dressed in white cloth along the glass.
The corridor narrows. White walls, read entirely in blue.
Color arrives: red, green and pink lights move across the walls.
Portrait screens along the windows, white line art on cyan.
Track spotlights and violet walls. The room brightens.
Leafy tropical plants in a long white planter. A green pause.
A red exit sign above a window onto the night city.
The hall opens onto a balcony. Guests line the glass rail.
Below us, the atrium and its black leather cubes.

dark: Pitch black. Let your eyes adjust. A teal orb floats ahead.
A dotted green line on the floor, a thin red bar of light. Keep going.
outro: That was NousCon NYC 2026, as the camera saw it.
Thank you for walking it with me. Come back to any room, anytime.
curator.ask_fallback: I can only speak to what was captured here. Try asking about one of the works.
race_start: A long corridor deserves a brisk walk. Shall we race?
Mind the flicker. I'll meet you further down.
race_go: On to the next pool of light.
dance: The disco floor. Forgive me a moment of joy.
One can't stand still in light like this.
nudge: Still with me? There's more to see ahead.
Take your time. When you're ready, scroll on.
Shall we continue? The next room is worth it.
Whenever you're ready, I'll lead the way.
Next is {title}, just ahead. Shall we?
crowd: A crowd. Usually a sign of something worth seeing.
A full room. A good problem for an event to have.
We'll step around. Everyone deserves a good look.
slow: An unhurried pace. That's how I'd see it too.
Take your time. The details reward it.
No hurry. Press the arrow firmly if you'd like to move faster.
jog: Quickening our step. Keep up the good taste.
